items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I put in, inserted, The Breeze and I (Andalusia), because I always remember her playing that at the piano

ctx.x: My mother had classical piano lessons when she was young, from what I understand, and would occasionally sit down and play. In fact, on my first record, Look How Far – my first official record as a leader, I did Pablo’s Story for Pablo Picasso, and at the end I – what’s the word? – I put in, inserted, The Breeze and I (Andalusia), because I always remember her playing that at the piano [Liebman hums a phrase of the melody]. That one.
I was going to ask you why you did that.
